description: The Chrome DevTools team's MCP server, standalone: launches its own headless Chrome with a temporary profile; Google usage statistics, CrUX lookups and update checks off. NOT for the kit: the Browser pool delivers this exact version through its gate. Needs Google Chrome, which the workspace image does not have.

slots.name: CHROME_DEVTOOLS_MCP_NO_USAGE_STATISTICS
slots.description: Turns off Google's usage statistics (also turned off by the flag).

slots.name: CHROME_DEVTOOLS_MCP_NO_UPDATE_CHECKS
slots.description: Turns off the periodic npm update check.
